verdict.rationale: Avalara ships an official AvaTax MCP server and REST API. They expose nexus handling, nexus definitions, transaction listing and lookup, and nexus creation, so an agent can read part of the tax posture and act on it. The other posture elements in the story are not documented as agent-readable through AvaTax. Missing for 10: registrations read access, accrued-liability views, upcoming-filings visibility through the API/MCP (Managed Returns is a separate partner filing API), scoped or least-privilege credentials for agents, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read my tax posture — nexus status, registrations, accrued liability, upcoming filings — and act on it through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: Provides access to the Avalara AvaTax API for tax calculation, transaction management, nexus handling, and compliance data.
Retrieves nexus definitions so you can determine tax obligations across jurisdictions.
Retrieves a list of transactions for a specific company, using filters to search.
Creates one or more new nexus declarations attached to this company
